name: RabbitM2
summary: RabbitM2 is a scalping EA that trades on the M1 timeframe using a combination of moving average crossovers and RSI-based entry signals. It aims to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets and moderate stop-losses. The EA implements a basic trend filter alongside momentum confirmation before opening positions.
summary_zh: RabbitM2是一个在M1时间周期上运行的剥头皮EA，结合移动平均线交叉和RSI指标作为入场信号。它通过较小的止盈目标和适度的止损来捕捉微小的价格波动。该EA在开仓前使用基础趋势过滤和动量确认机制。
strategy_analysis: RabbitM2策略基于短期移动平均线交叉与RSI超买超卖区域的组合信号进行交易。入场条件为快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI处于特定阈值范围内时做多，反之为做空。出场条件包括固定的止盈和止损水平，以及均线下穿时的趋势反转出场。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例计算，每笔交易使用相同手数，未考虑账户净值变化。整体策略设计较为简单，适合低波动市场环境下的短线交易，但在高波动或震荡剧烈的市场中可能面临连续止损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: RabbitM2 strategy is based on a combination of short-term moving average crossover and RSI overbought/oversold zone signals for trade entries. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI is within a specific threshold range, with the reverse for sell entries. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as trend reversal exits when the MAs cross in the opposite direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management lacks risk-proportional calculation, using the same lot size for every trade regardless of account equity changes. The overall strategy design is relatively simple, suitable for short-term trading in low-volatility market environments, but may face consecutive stop-losses in highly volatile or violently oscillating markets.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码用于识别订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调整参数
结合趋势和动量双重过滤，减少虚假信号
固定止盈止损有助于控制单笔交易风险
M1时间周期适合快速进出的短线交易需求
魔术号码机制可避免与其他EA订单冲突
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Dual filtering with both trend and momentum reduces false signals
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss helps control per-trade risk
M1 timeframe suits quick in-and-out short-term trading needs
Magic number mechanism prevents order conflicts with other EAs
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户资金变化，风险暴露不灵活
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下容易亏损
未实现新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有追踪止损或动态止盈机制，无法锁定浮动利润
RSI阈值固定不变，无法适应不同市场波动环境
cons_en: Fixed lot size ignores account equity changes, inflexible risk exposure
Lacks spread filter, prone to losses in high-spread environments
No new bar check implemented, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
No trailing stop or dynamic take-profit mechanism to lock in floating profits
Fixed RSI thresholds cannot adapt to different market volatility conditions
improvements: 增加动态仓位计算功能，根据账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
添加点差过滤和新K线检查机制，提高交易安全性和避免重复开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lots based on account balance and risk ratio
Add spread filter and new bar check mechanism to improve trading safety and avoid duplicate entries

risk_points: M1剥头皮交易在高点差和滑点环境下风险较大
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上多次开仓
固定手数未根据账户净值动态调整，存在过度交易风险
未检测市场波动率变化，剧烈行情中止损可能被快速击穿
risk_points_en: M1 scalping carries significant risk in high spread and slippage environments
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar
Fixed lot size without dynamic adjustment based on account equity poses overtrading risk
No market volatility detection means stop-losses can be quickly hit during volatile conditions

It aims to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets and moderate stop-losses. The EA implements a basic trend filter alongside momentum confirmation before opening positions.
